name: Out-of-Core Frustum Clipping
definition: A stage where each rendering node determines which parts of the dataset to display based on the current view, loading only the required subvolume at the maximum resolution fitting into texture memory.
summary: Out-of-Core Frustum Clipping is a visibility culling method that couples geometric frustum tests with resolution selection to ensure loaded subvolumes fit within strict texture memory limits for out-of-core streaming.
